basic_info.description: Perfectly positioned on the Marina's most coveted corner, this top-floor residence captures picturesque views over Avila Street and unrivaled access to the best of city living. Just steps from the tranquil waterfront and the vibrant energy of Chestnut Street, every amenity is mere steps away. Bathed in natural light from windows on all sides, the home showcases refined Spanish Mediterranean detailsarched wall cut-outs, elegant trim, and generously scaled rooms. The living room offers an inviting vantage point year-round, framed by Avila Street outlooks. Through dramatic entryways, the formal dining room seamlessly connects to a stylishly updated kitchen, where peek-a-boo views of the Golden Gate Bridge add allure to everyday meal prep. The sunlit primary suite serves as a private retreat with a dedicated deck, walk-in closet, and easy access to the luxurious, spa-like bathroom. The second bedroom, with windows on all sides and an en-suite bathroom, ensures comfort and privacy. Enjoy the luxury of an intimate two-unit building, with air conditioning in key rooms, a private 2-car garage with storage, easy access private laundry, and thoughtful classic details throughout. A rare blend of light, soul, and location don't miss this timeless sanctuary in the heart of the Marina!
